resources.string: Schematic drawing of an insulin pump with a screen and four buttons: back, up, down and confirm. The pump screen shows: %1$s.
Schematic only. Button positions and wording differ on your pump.
The wording on your pump can differ slightly depending on its software version.
What to do on the pump
What you can do here in the app
This app never confirms an alert by itself. It only happens when you tap Confirm or Snooze.
Snooze is not available because this alert is already snoozed.
Done. The pump accepted your choice.
The pump did not accept this. Check that the pump is nearby and try again, or handle the alert on the pump.
This is the simulated pump. No insulin is delivered.
No pump data yet. Tap Refresh when the pump is nearby.
Age of the data is unknown
These values are older than 15 minutes and may no longer be correct. Refresh, or check the pump itself.
%1$s U running, %2$s U still to go
The pump could not be reached. The values above are the last known ones.
Keep pump connected all the time
Off (recommended): the bridge connects to the pump only when Trio needs it. On: the connection stays open, which reacts faster but uses noticeably more pump battery.
The current pump pairing is replaced. While you do this, Trio cannot control the pump. You need the pump in your hands.
Unpairing removes a connection. Trio cannot use it until you pair again. Choose what to unpair.

The bridge forgets the pump. Trio can no longer read or control the pump through this phone until you pair it again. The pump keeps running its normal basal program on its own. Also remove this phone on the pump under Menu > Settings > Communication > Remove Device.
The bridge forgets the iPhone. Trio can no longer send commands until you pair the iPhone again. Pump alerts are still shown here and in the notification.
Newest entry at the bottom. The log never contains keys or codes.
Battery optimization is on for this app. Android may stop the bridge in the background, and Trio would lose its pump connection.
Notifications are off. You would not see pump alerts or bridge problems.
Bluetooth is off. The bridge cannot talk to the pump or the iPhone.
Bluetooth permissions are missing. The bridge cannot run.
The simulated pump is switched on, but a real pump is paired. The bridge refuses to run so that the simulator can never replace the real pump by accident.
The bridge is not visible to the iPhone. Trio cannot connect.
For testing only. Do not use while you rely on the pump.

The simulator replaces the real pump with a program on this phone, so you can test Trio without a pump. No insulin is ever delivered. It is mutually exclusive with a paired real pump, and it is never used automatically.
Not available: a real pump is paired. Unpair the pump first.
While the simulator is on, pairing a real pump is blocked. Switch the simulator off first to pair a real pump.
Refused: a real pump is paired.
The simulator is starting. Injection buttons appear in a moment.
This replaces the real pump with a simulator. No insulin is delivered. Use only for testing with Trio.
Ends uncertain (pump did NOT execute it)
Bluetooth talks to your pump and iPhone. Notifications show pump alerts.
Needed to find the pump, to connect to it and to be visible to the iPhone. On Android 11 and older Android calls this \"Location\"; the app does not use your location.
Needed to show pump alerts and to warn you if the bridge has a problem.
Bluetooth is switched off on this phone. Switch it on in the quick settings.
Notifications are not allowed. You can continue, but you will not see pump alerts. Please allow them.
Bluetooth permission is required. Without it the bridge cannot work.
Android asks once or twice. Tap Allow each time.
Android must not stop the bridge while the screen is off.
Without this, Trio can lose the pump without warning.
Android asks to let the app run in the background. Tap Allow.
Your phone maker may add its own app killer. Switch it off for InsightBridge.
Your phone has no direct link to that screen, so the general app settings were opened. Look for Battery, Autostart or Background activity there.
More phone-specific help: dontkillmyapp.com (open it in a browser yourself; this app uses no internet).
A settings screen opens. Change the options, then come back.

1. Open Settings > Battery > Background usage limits.
2. Make sure InsightBridge is NOT in "Sleeping apps" or "Deep sleeping apps".
3. Add InsightBridge to "Never sleeping apps".
4. In the app's own battery settings choose "Unrestricted".

1. Turn on \"Autostart\" for InsightBridge.\n2. Open Settings > Apps > InsightBridge > Battery saver and choose \"No restrictions\".\n3. In the recent-apps view, lock InsightBridge (pull the card down or tap the lock) so it is not cleared.
1. Open Settings > Apps > App launch (or Battery > App launch).\n2. Switch InsightBridge to \"Manage manually\".\n3. Turn on all three options: Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

1. Allow \"Auto-launch\" (also called Autostart) for InsightBridge.\n2. Open Settings > Battery > InsightBridge and allow \"Background activity\" (\"Allow background activity\").\n3. Choose \"Don\'t optimize\" for the app if offered.
1. Allow \"Autostart\" for InsightBridge.\n2. Open Settings > Battery > Background power consumption and choose \"Allow high background power consumption\" for InsightBridge.
1. Turn on \"Autostart\" for InsightBridge.\n2. In the battery settings choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Performance\" for the app.

Open Settings > Apps > InsightBridge > Battery and choose \"Unrestricted\" (or \"No restrictions\"). If your phone has an Autostart, App launch or Background activity setting, allow it for InsightBridge.
Pairing a real pump is blocked while the simulator is on. To pair a real pump, switch the simulator off first in the developer settings.
An Insight pump is already paired with this phone.
Pair again only for a different pump or if it does not connect.
Remove old devices from the pump
Only needed if the pump was used with the meter or another phone.
Next you open Add Device on the pump.
A list of the devices known to the pump. Select the old device and confirm removing it.
The pump then shows its serial number.
The pump shows its serial number
This phone searches for the pump. Keep it within one metre.
The pump shows \"Add Device\" and, after you confirm, a screen with the pump\'s serial number.
Tap the entry with the serial number shown on the pump.
The pump shows its serial number and \"Waiting for connection\".
Tap to pair with this pump
Android may ask to pair. Tap Pair. Then both devices show a code.
Connecting. If Android asks whether to pair, tap Pair. Keep the pump on its serial number screen.
Is the pump showing exactly this code?
If yes: confirm on the pump, then tap Yes here. If not: tap No.
A verification code of 10 characters in groups of three, and a check mark to confirm.
Yes, the codes are the same
Finishing. Do not close the app and keep the pump close.
Pairing completed. The pump is now connected to this phone.
The pump confirms that pairing is completed.
Next: pair the iPhone that runs Trio.
Tap Try again. You will start again from the pump\'s Add Device screen. Nothing was paired.
Pairing was rejected, either by you or by the pump. Nothing was paired. Never accept codes that differ. Start again.
The pump did not answer in time. Keep the pump close, make sure it still shows the Add Device screen, and try again.
Could not connect to the pump
The connection failed. Typical reasons: the pump already knows another device or its device list is full, the pump left the Add Device screen, or it is too far away. See the help below.
Bluetooth is off or the Bluetooth permission is missing. Switch Bluetooth on and allow the permission, then try again.
Something unexpected went wrong. Nothing was paired. Try again. If it keeps failing, remove old devices from the pump and restart the phone\'s Bluetooth.
Start a 2-minute window, then pick Accu-Chek Insight in Trio.
1. Open Trio › Settings › Pump.\n2. Choose Accu-Chek Insight.\n3. Trio finds this bridge. Tap it.
Both phones then show a 6-digit code to compare.
An iPhone is already paired with this bridge.
Pair again only if Trio cannot connect.
A 6-digit code appears here once Trio connects.
Does the iPhone show exactly this code?
Waiting for the iPhone to confirm…
The iPhone has confirmed the code.
You confirmed. Waiting for the pairing to finish…
If yes: tap Yes here and confirm on the iPhone. If not: tap No.
The iPhone is paired with this bridge.
No iPhone paired within 2 minutes. Nothing was paired.
Pairing was rejected. Nothing was paired. Never accept codes that differ.
The pairing could not be saved
The phone could not store the pairing securely. Nothing was paired. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the phone.
The connection to the iPhone broke off. Nothing was paired. Try again.
Tap Try again for a new 2-minute window, then pick Accu-Chek Insight in Trio again.
This is the current state of the bridge.
The iPhone is not paired yet. Trio cannot use the pump until you pair it. You can do that later from the main screen.
No pump is paired yet. Trio cannot use the pump until you pair it.
Keep this phone charged with Bluetooth on.
The bridge keeps running. The main screen warns you if something needs attention.
Tap \"Open app settings\", then Permissions, and allow \"Nearby devices\" (on older Android: Location) and Notifications. Then come back to this screen.
Bluetooth is off or permission is missing

Switch Bluetooth on in the quick settings. Also check that the Bluetooth permission (\"Nearby devices\", on Android 11 and older \"Location\") is allowed for InsightBridge in the app settings. On Android 11 and older, Location services must also be on for scanning.
The battery screen did not open
Open the phone\'s Settings > Apps > InsightBridge > Battery and choose \"Unrestricted\" (or \"Don\'t optimize\"). Then come back here.
My phone is not in the list

Look in Settings > Apps > InsightBridge and in the battery settings for options named Autostart, Auto-launch, App launch, Background activity or Sleeping apps, and allow background running. The website dontkillmyapp.com lists phone-specific steps (open it in a browser yourself).

The pump and the phone did not finish pairing in time. On the pump open Menu > Settings > Communication > Add Device again so the serial number is shown, keep the phone within one metre, then tap Try again.
My pump is not in the list

1. The pump must show the serial number screen (Menu > Settings > Communication > Add Device). It is visible only for a short time.
2. Keep the pump within one metre of the phone.
3. Check that Bluetooth is on.
4. Tap Search again.
5. If still nothing: the pump may be connected to another device or its device list may be full. Remove old devices first.

Tap No on the phone and reject on the pump. Nothing is paired. Pairing is retried from the start when you tap Try again. Do not confirm codes that are not identical: a different code can mean that another device is in between.
Pump already paired with another device, or device list full

The pump should only be connected to one device at a time. Remove the old device on the pump: Menu > Settings > Communication > Remove Device, choose the old device and confirm. This also applies to the Insight remote control (meter) and to any other phone. Then open Add Device again and retry.
Trio does not find the bridge

Keep this screen open while the countdown runs. On the iPhone check that Bluetooth is on and that Trio is allowed to use Bluetooth. Keep both phones side by side. On this phone Bluetooth must be on. If it still fails, tap Cancel here, then start again.
Tap Try again to open a new window, then pick Accu-Chek Insight in Trio within 2 minutes.
Tap No. Nothing is paired. Make sure you are pairing your own iPhone, then try again. Never confirm a code that is not identical.
If you want to start fresh, use Unpair iPhone on the main screen, remove the bridge in Trio as well, and pair again.
The pump\'s bolus reminder went off. It reminds you to deliver a bolus at this time. Nothing is wrong with the pump.
Confirm the reminder on the pump. Deliver a bolus only the way you normally do.
The pump reminds you that no bolus was delivered at a time when you usually take one.
Confirm the reminder on the pump. Decide as you normally do whether a bolus is needed.
The alarm clock that was set on the pump went off.
Confirm the alarm on the pump.
The reminder to change the infusion set is due.
Confirm the reminder on the pump and change the infusion set when you can.
A temporary basal rate (TBR) has finished. The pump continues with the normal basal rate.
Confirm the message on the pump. Check that the pump shows the basal rate you expect.
The insulin cartridge is almost empty. Insulin delivery continues until it runs out.
Confirm the warning on the pump. Prepare a new cartridge and change it soon, before the old one is empty.
The pump battery is almost empty. If it runs out, the pump stops delivering insulin and Trio cannot control it.
Confirm the warning on the pump and change the battery soon. Keep a spare battery with you.
The clock of the pump is not valid, for example after a battery change. Basal and history times may be wrong until it is set.
Confirm the warning on the pump and set the correct time and date on the pump.
The warranty period of the pump has ended. The pump keeps working.
Confirm the warning on the pump. Contact Accu-Chek customer support about your pump.
A temporary basal rate (TBR) was cancelled before its end. The pump may be running the normal basal rate now.
Confirm the warning on the pump and check which basal rate the pump is running.
A bolus was cancelled before it was finished. Only part of the programmed amount may have been delivered.
Confirm the warning on the pump and check in the pump history how much was delivered. Consider checking your blood glucose.
The loan period of the pump is about to end.
Confirm the warning on the pump. Contact Accu-Chek customer support in good time.
The pump does not detect a cartridge, so it cannot deliver insulin. Trio cannot dose until this is fixed.
Insert a cartridge as shown on the pump display. Consider checking your blood glucose while no insulin is delivered.
The cartridge is empty. The pump cannot deliver insulin, and Trio cannot dose until it is changed.
Change the cartridge on the pump. Consider checking your blood glucose while no insulin is delivered.
The pump battery is empty. The pump has stopped delivering insulin, and Trio cannot control it.
Change the battery on the pump now. Consider checking your blood glucose while no insulin is delivered.
The pump stopped itself because it was not operated for the automatic-off time that is set on the pump. No insulin is being delivered.
Check the pump status on the pump and restart insulin delivery there. Consider checking your blood glucose.
The pump detected a blockage. Insulin may not be reaching your body through the infusion set.
Check the infusion set and tubing and change the infusion set if needed. Consider checking your blood glucose.
The loan period of the pump is over and the pump has reached the end of its operation. Trio cannot control it.
Contact Accu-Chek customer support. Use your backup plan for insulin delivery in the meantime.
A cartridge change was started on the pump but not finished. The pump is not delivering insulin.
Finish the cartridge change on the pump, or change the cartridge again. Consider checking your blood glucose.
A data transfer between the pump and another device failed. Insulin delivery is not affected by this message.
Confirm the message on the pump. If Trio reports problems, check the pump connection in this app.
The pump was paused longer than allowed and has stopped. No insulin is being delivered.
Check the pump status on the pump and restart insulin delivery there. Consider checking your blood glucose.
The type of battery has not been set on the pump, so the pump cannot show battery status reliably.
Set the battery type on the pump.
The type of cartridge has not been set on the pump, so the pump cannot show the insulin amount reliably.
Set the cartridge type on the pump.
The pump found a mechanical fault and has stopped. The pump needs attention, and Trio cannot continue until it is resolved.
Change the battery and the cartridge as the pump asks. If the error comes back, contact Accu-Chek customer support. Check your blood glucose and use your backup plan.
The pump could not complete the rewind step of a cartridge change and has stopped. The pump needs attention, and Trio cannot continue until it is resolved.
Change the cartridge as the pump asks. If the error comes back, contact Accu-Chek customer support. Check your blood glucose and use your backup plan.
The pump found a problem with its language data and has stopped. The pump needs attention, and Trio cannot continue until it is resolved.
Change the language setting on the pump as it asks. If the error comes back, contact Accu-Chek customer support. Check your blood glucose and use your backup plan.
The pump reported an alert that this app does not know. Look at the pump display to see what it says.
Read the message on the pump display and follow its instructions.
You can confirm the reminder here, or snooze it to be reminded later. Trio can also confirm it.
Confirm or snooze here once you have read the warning. The cause is dealt with on the pump. Trio can also confirm.
Confirm or snooze here only after you have seen the message. The cause must be fixed on the pump. Trio can also confirm.
An error usually cannot be cleared from here until the pump has been fixed. Confirm only after you have checked the pump.
A real pump cannot be paired while the simulated pump is switched on. Switch the simulator off in the developer settings first.
